note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $cli { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep01 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $cli -Path $msi -Destination C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Start-Process msiexec.exe '/i C:\lab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1' -Wait } }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { if (-not (Get-WindowsFeature Web-Server).Installed) { Install-WindowsFeature Web-Server | Out-Null } }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'alex.demo'")) { New-ADUser -Name 'Alex Demo' -SamAccountName alex.demo -UserPrincipalName alex.demo@lab.contoso.com -Enabled $false } }

$r = Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { $g = [ADSI]'WinNT://./Administrators,group'; foreach ($m in @($g.Invoke('Members'))) { $path = ([ADSI]$m).Path; if ($path -match 'WinNT://S-1-5-21-') { $g.Remove($path) } }; net localgroup Administrators 'CONTOSO\alex.demo' /add 2>&1 | Out-Null; Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Public -Enabled False; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections -Value 0; $x = Install-WindowsFeature FS-FileServer, FS-SMB1; "$($x.RestartNeeded)" }

if ("$r" -eq 'Yes') { Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Restart-Computer -Force }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 } until ((Get-VMIntegrationService -VMName CON-SRV02 -Name Heartbeat).PrimaryStatusDescription -eq 'OK'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Get-WindowsFeature FS-FileServer, FS-SMB1 | Format-Table Name, InstallState -AutoSize | Out-String; Get-NetFirewallProfile | Format-Table Name, Enabled -AutoSize | Out-String; 'fDenyTSConnections=' + (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server').fDenyTSConnections; net localgroup Administrators } | Out-Host

screens.name: fixed
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-SRV02 { Uninstall-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1; Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Public -Enabled True }

screens.name: hotfix
commands: # Windows Update history (what Settings > Update history shows):

teardown: $t = Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { net localgroup Administrators 'CONTOSO\alex.demo' /delete 2>&1 | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections -Value 1; Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Public -Enabled True; $x = Uninstall-WindowsFeature FS-SMB1, FS-FileServer; "$($x.RestartNeeded)" }

if ("$t" -eq 'Yes') { Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Restart-Computer -Force }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 } until ((Get-VMIntegrationService -VMName CON-SRV02 -Name Heartbeat).PrimaryStatusDescription -eq 'OK') }
